summary: the pwauthfault, accounttools, initpolicy and ncwrite host tests with 25 faults in private copies of utils/pwauth.c, login.c, su.c, sudo.c, init.c and nc.c; the test runs each program in a process group of its own for at most 15 seconds, ends the group, and prints the program's status

argv: set -e; for t in pwauthfault accounttools initpolicy ncwrite; do ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${SRC}/utils -I utils -I tests/host/compat tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest; done

st=0; for t in pwauthfault accounttools initpolicy ncwrite; do s=0; perl -e 'setpgrp(0, 0); alarm 15; exec @ARGV or die "account-proof: exec: $!\n"' ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest & pid=$!; wait $pid || s=$?; kill -TERM -$pid 2>/dev/null || :; while kill -0 -$pid 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; echo "account-proof: $t: status $s"; [ $s -eq 0 ] || st=1; done; exit $st
